```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)

data("instacart")

aisle_counts =
  instacart |>
  count(aisle) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 15)

order_times =
  instacart |>
  distinct(order_id, order_dow, order_hour_of_day) |>
  count(order_dow, order_hour_of_day) |>
  mutate(day_of_week = str_c("Day ", order_dow))

reorder_by_number =
  instacart |>
  group_by(order_id, order_number) |>
  summarize(reorder_prop = mean(reordered), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(order_number) |>
  summarize(
    n_orders = n(),
    mean_prop = mean(reorder_prop),
    se = sd(reorder_prop) / sqrt(n_orders)) |>
  filter(n_orders >= 100, order_number < 100) |>
  mutate(
    lower = mean_prop - 1.96 * se,
    upper = mean_prop + 1.96 * se)
```

Column {data-width=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Top 15 aisles by number of items ordered

```{r}
aisle_counts |>
  mutate(
    aisle = fct_reorder(aisle, n),
    text_label = str_c(aisle, "\nItems ordered: ", n)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~n, y = ~aisle, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
    text = ~text_label, hoverinfo = "text", textposition = "none",
    marker = list(color = "#2f5d50")) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of items ordered"),
    yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

Column {data-width=550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Number of orders by day of week and hour of day

```{r}
order_times |>
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c(
      day_of_week, ", ", order_hour_of_day, ":00",
      "\nNumber of orders: ", n)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_hour_of_day, y = ~day_of_week, z = ~n,
    type = "heatmap",
    colors = "YlOrRd",
    xgap = 2, ygap = 2,
    text = ~text_label, hoverinfo = "text",
    colorbar = list(title = "Orders")) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Hour of day", dtick = 2, showgrid = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed", showgrid = FALSE))
```



### Proportion of reordered items by customer's order number

```{r}
reorder_by_number |>
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c(
      "Order number: ", order_number,
      "\nMean reorder proportion: ", round(mean_prop * 100, 1), "%",
      "\n95% CI: ", round(lower * 100, 1), "% to ", round(upper * 100, 1), "%",
      "\nNumber of orders: ", n_orders)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~order_number) |>
  add_ribbons(
    ymin = ~lower, ymax = ~upper,
    fillcolor = "rgba(47, 93, 80, 0.2)",
    line = list(color = "transparent"),
    name = "95% CI", hoverinfo = "skip") |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~mean_prop,
    line = list(color = "#2f5d50"),
    name = "Mean",
    text = ~text_label, hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Customer's order number"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Proportion of reordered items", tickformat = ".0%"),
    legend = list(x = 0.75, y = 0.1))
```
